Refit fastlmm model with new delta

Source: R/refitModel.R
refitModel.Rd

Refit fastlmm model with new delta value

Usage

refitModel(fit, delta)

Arguments

fit

model fit of class fastlmm

delta

new value for delta

Details

Useful for evaluating log-likelihood and multiple values of delta

Examples

library(lme4)

fit <- fastlmm(Reaction ~ Days + (1 | Subject), sleepstudy)
#> Error in fastlmm.fit(Y = Y, X = X, Z = Z, offset = offset, rank = ncol(Z),     weights = weights, REML = REML, delta = delta, delta.range = delta.range,     tol = tol, nthreads = nthreads): object 'fit' not found

summary(fit)
#> Error in h(simpleError(msg, call)): error in evaluating the argument 'object' in selecting a method for function 'summary': object 'fit' not found

summary(refitModel(fit, delta=1000))
#> Error in h(simpleError(msg, call)): error in evaluating the argument 'object' in selecting a method for function 'summary': object 'fit' not found
